description: Check whether a blockpage's profile content is actually retrievable from IPFS — the pin-status companion to lookup_blockpage. Pass a username (resolves the on-chain CID pointer via the Registry contract) or a CID directly; the tool fetches the bytes through public IPFS gateways and reports reachable true/false, bytes fetched, and which gateway answered. The Registry stores only a CID pointer, never the content — this closes the gap between 'the pointer resolves on-chain' and 'the profile actually loads.'

cid.description: IPFS CID to check directly (Qm… or baf…)

username.description: Voicescape username whose profile CID to check (e.g. forge)

name: check_profile_pin
title: Check profile pin
